title: IT Auditor
full_description:
Amsterdam, Netherlands
€3.872,12 - €6.345,61
ING is looking for a (Senior) IT Auditor - Wholesale Banking & Payment Settlement Services: An experienced  IT Auditor to execute IT Audits in the Netherlands and international ING entities. Audits can include technology topics such as private cloud, APIs, Databases, Operating Systems and Containers. Audits focus on the technology risks of automated business processes in the areas of Payments, Financial Markets, Lending , Cash management and Internet/Mobile Banking.
Corporate Audit Services is ING’s internal audit department and consists of around 410 team members globally. As IT Auditor you will be located in Amsterdam within the team Tech Wholesale Banking & Payments Settlement Services. This team consists of 9 members located in Amsterdam, Romania and Asia.
You will work in a positive working atmosphere where people are used to an open communication style. Education and training is highly supported and innovation is stimulated.
